metadata.title: Google Cloud Vertex AI & Gemini 1.5 Pro SAIF Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Enterprise OSCAL Component Definition for Google Gemini 1.5 Pro hosted on Vertex AI, incorporating Google Secure AI Framework (SAIF) controls, FedRAMP High and DoD IL5 authorizations, Model Armor, SynthID watermarking, grounding checks, and VPC Service Controls.

components.title: Google Cloud Vertex AI - Gemini 1.5 Pro Foundation Model Service
components.description: Fully managed enterprise foundation model service offering Google Gemini 1.5 Pro on Vertex AI. Governed under Google's Secure AI Framework (SAIF), featuring Model Armor semantic protection, DeepMind SynthID digital watermarking, Vertex AI Grounding factuality attributions, Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK), VPC Service Controls perimeters, and FedRAMP High / DoD IL5 provisional authorizations.
components.purpose: Provides multimodal generative AI capabilities (text, vision, audio, video, code) with up to 2 million token context window, schema-constrained generation, and enterprise security guardrails for federal and commercial workloads.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control implementations for Google Cloud Vertex AI Gemini 1.5 Pro aligned with Google Secure AI Framework (SAIF) principles.

implemented-requirements.description: Access to Google Cloud Vertex AI Gemini 1.5 Pro endpoints is strictly controlled via Google Cloud Identity and Access Management (Cloud IAM). Fine-grained permissions (e.g., aiplatform.endpoints.predict, aiplatform.models.get) are evaluated on every REST/gRPC API invocation. Authorization is further enforced via IAM Conditions (time-bounded, IP-bounded) and Workload Identity Federation for containerized agents.

Information flows between customer clients, private networks, and Gemini 1.5 Pro are strictly enforced through VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) perimeters, Private Service Connect (PSC), and Vertex AI Model Armor. VPC-SC blocks unauthorized cross-project egress and prevents data exfiltration. Model Armor enforces bidirectional semantic inspection to filter prompt injection, malicious instructions, and sensitive PII from outbound responses.

values: Google VPC Service Controls perimeters around aiplatform.googleapis.com, Private Service Connect endpoints, and Vertex AI Model Armor semantic flow filters

implemented-requirements.description: Vertex AI Gemini 1.5 Pro implements least privilege through predefined granular IAM roles (e.g., roles/aiplatform.user for model invocation without administrative rights, roles/aiplatform.viewer for read-only telemetry, and dedicated project service agent accounts). Administrative and service credentials are short-lived via OAuth2 token minting and Service Account Impersonation, eliminating long-lived standing keys.

Google Cloud Audit Logs automatically records all administrative operations (Admin Activity logs) and data access calls (Data Access logs) for Gemini 1.5 Pro inference, fine-tuning, context caching, and batch prediction jobs. Logs are immutable and forwarded to Cloud Logging and Security Command Center.

Cloud Audit Logs for Vertex AI Gemini 1.5 Pro captures detailed structured audit events containing event type, microsecond timestamp, regional endpoint, caller source IP/network, gRPC/HTTP status code, and full principal identity and authorization tokens.

statements.description: Logs capture the exact API method invoked (e.g., google.cloud.aiplatform.v1.PredictionService.GenerateContent, CountTokens, or CreateBatchPredictionJob).
Logs record RFC 3339 timestamps with microsecond precision indicating when the request was admitted and executed.
Logs record the location and service endpoint (e.g., us-central1-aiplatform.googleapis.com or Assured Workloads FedRAMP High boundary region).
Logs record the caller source IP address, client user-agent, VPC network, and service mesh transit identity.
Logs record the operation outcome including HTTP status codes, gRPC status (OK, PERMISSION_DENIED, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED), and error details.
Logs record the caller identity, authenticated principal email (user or service account), credential ID, and delegated impersonation chain.

implemented-requirements.description: All foundation models, versions, and deployment endpoints are tracked in Vertex AI Model Garden and Model Registry. Model cards document architecture, training lineage, evaluation benchmarks, and safety evaluations. Cloud Asset Inventory indexes active endpoints, IAM bindings, and CMEK key associations.

Vertex AI Gemini 1.5 Pro enforces customer data isolation and zero-day prompt retention by default. Prompts and completions are processed ephemerally in RAM and are not logged or stored on persistent storage for model training. Context Caching memory allocations are governed by strict customer-configured TTL expiration. Cloud Storage datasets and model artifacts are cryptographically shredded upon deletion through Cloud KMS CMEK key destruction.

values: ephemeral inference memory buffers, Vertex AI Context Caching token allocations, and CMEK-encrypted Cloud Storage buckets
Zero-day retention memory clearing upon response delivery, TTL automated expiration, and NIST SP 800-88 Rev 1 cryptographic erasure via Cloud KMS key destruction

implemented-requirements.description: Boundary protection is provided via VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) and Private Service Connect (PSC). Gemini 1.5 Pro inference endpoints are placed behind private VPC endpoints, isolating network traffic from the public Internet. Assured Workloads enforces geographical boundary protection, restricting data and personnel access to US soil for FedRAMP High and DoD IL5.

values: VPC Service Controls perimeters, Private Service Connect endpoints, and Assured Workloads boundary restrictions

implemented-requirements.description: All communication channels to Google Cloud Vertex AI Gemini 1.5 Pro require TLS 1.3 (with fallback to TLS 1.2 using FIPS 140-2 validated cipher suites). Internal communication across Google cluster boundaries is secured using Application Layer Transport Security (ALTS) hardware-authenticated mutual transport encryption.

values: TLS 1.3 with FIPS-validated cipher suites for external REST/gRPC APIs, and Google Application Layer Transport Security (ALTS) for internal cluster communications

implemented-requirements.description: Customer-managed keys are provisioned, rotated, and managed in Google Cloud Key Management Service (Cloud KMS) and Cloud HSM (FIPS 140-2 Level 3 / FIPS 140-3). Key access policies enforce separation of duties and automated rotation schedules.

All data at rest associated with Gemini 1.5 Pro—including model fine-tuning weights, training datasets, Vector Search embeddings, and Context Caching stores—is encrypted using Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) backed by Cloud KMS using AES-256 in Galois/Counter Mode (GCM). Disabling the customer KMS key renders all associated model data instantaneously unreadable.

values: AES-256 encryption via Cloud KMS Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK)
Gemini fine-tuning datasets, Vector Search embeddings, Context Caching stores, and customer model evaluation logs

implemented-requirements.description: Under Google's Secure AI Framework (SAIF), Vertex AI Model Armor acts as an inline AI firewall to intercept and sanitize prompt injection, jailbreaking attempts, and adversarial evasion attacks. Real-time semantic inspection detects multi-turn prompt injection and indirect injection from untrusted RAG contexts, returning BLOCK_SAFETY dispositions before execution by Gemini 1.5 Pro.

values: Vertex AI Model Armor semantic AI firewall, SAIF adversarial ML filters, and Gemini safety threshold classifiers
real-time inline inspection on all prompt inputs and generated completions
block prompt execution, sanitize output payload, return BLOCK_SAFETY disposition, and emit Cloud Security Command Center threat findings
Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) and customer Security Operations Center (SOC)

implemented-requirements.description: Information and artifact integrity is enforced across the AI lifecycle. DeepMind SynthID embeds imperceptible, robust digital watermarks directly into synthetic content generated by Gemini 1.5 Pro to verify provenance and detect unauthorized manipulation. Grounding factuality checks compute attribution confidence scores against enterprise datastores. Container images and model checkpoints are cryptographically signed and verified via Binary Authorization.

values: Gemini 1.5 Pro synthetic generations, grounding attributions, model container images, and model weights
embed DeepMind SynthID digital watermarks, evaluate grounding citation confidence thresholds, and reject unsigned model containers via Google Binary Authorization

implemented-requirements.description: Vertex AI Gemini 1.5 Pro implements strict input validation and boundary delimiter isolation. The API supports native system instructions (system_instruction) separated from user dialogue turns, preventing instruction confusion attacks. Structured outputs are strictly constrained via response_schema (JSON schema validation) to prevent malformed or malicious downstream payloads.

values: user prompts, system instruction envelopes, RAG context payloads, and structured JSON response schemas
